# Will an indoor golf simulator room make money? Monthly profit, payback and break-even utilization

> Free calculator for indoor golf simulator lounges and bay-rental venues. Enter bays, peak and off-peak rates, utilization, members, food and drink, rent and staff; it shows monthly profit, margin, payback on the build, break-even utilization, the lowest rates for your target margin, and compares a second scenario.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
